name: 23002 · Amelia Ct Hse, VA
findings: ZIP 23002 (Amelia Ct Hse) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23002 (Amelia Ct Hse) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23002 (Amelia Ct Hse) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).
